responsibility: Implements loop if-conversion on GIMPLE, primarily to enable vectorization and related loop transforms. The pass analyzes conditional loop bodies, tracks per-block predicates, rewrites conditionally executed statements into predicated or select-like forms, handles PHIs, memory references, and bitfield corner cases, may version loops when full predication is unsafe or profitability-dependent, then merges converted blocks and repairs SSA/CFG for downstream vectorizer and loop passes.
same_name_distinction: Contains the full loop if-conversion algorithm and pass driver, including analysis, predication/rewriting, loop versioning, block merging, and SSA/CFG repair. Unlike gcc/tree-if-conv.h, this file implements the transformation rather than merely declaring its entry point.
